_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x8Be2AAcUBhodBsvnWLd3Xs)_
Fixes #35212
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：平台测试清单里新增一条测试项，检查首页、对象列表页和记录页的首屏加载时间是否在 2.5 秒以内。
- 为什么做：北极星核心功能与测试清单对齐专题的最后一项，即页面首屏加载时间，按已定的阈值写成可执行的测试项。
- 出错会怎样：只改测试清单，不碰产品代码；测试项写错可以直接改或撤回，不影响任何用户。
- 要你做什么：基线读数显示三个页面都超过 2.5 秒，需要你决定是否另开提速工作。

## What changes

One item appended to `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ux-conventions.json`, authored through `checklist-author` against the README's item anatomy: `ux-conventions.first-screen-lcp`, `active`, P1, browser. No other file changes. It closes the ux 6 row of PR #37165's mapping ("gap, out of scope here: not a checklist capability until a threshold exists"), now that ruling 7178954860 sets the threshold.

The item encodes the ruling as written, no stricter and no looser:

- **Threshold:** LCP at most 2.5 s, as a per-page clause (median of 5 at or below 2500 ms).
- **Conditions:** signed in, cold cache, Lighthouse's desktop preset as shipped (about 10 Mbps, 40 ms RTT, no CPU throttle, a desktop viewport). Lighthouse's default storage reset before each run clears the HTTP cache, cache storage and service workers, and keeps cookies and localStorage. So every run is on a cold cache and signed in.
- **Reading:** the median of 5 runs on each of home (`/_console/home`), an object list (`/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task`) and a record page (`.../showcase_task/record/:id`).
- **Before it gates:** the baseline reading is taken in this PR and recorded in the item's `history` (revision 1).

Two more clauses keep a run honest. Each scored run must measure the page itself, signed in, with nothing served from cache. And the `configSettings` block must show the desktop profile. Traps: `stale-console-bundle`, `first-boot-cold-start`. One new anchor, `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx#App`, which resolves.

## Baseline reading

| | |
|:--|:--|
| Commit measured | `db77cc493a` (main; the item commit `93707e6ed9` changes only the ledger) |
| App | showcase, `OS_PORT=38517 pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38517`; workspace built from that tree and the Console rebuilt from it (`pnpm console:build`) |
| Signed in as | the dev admin the fresh boot seeds, through the Console login form; the session held for every run (final URL never `/login`) |
| Tool | Lighthouse 13.6.0, node API, `core/config/desktop-config.js`, performance category only |
| Profile | formFactor desktop, throttlingMethod simulate, rttMs 40, throughputKbps 10240, cpuSlowdownMultiplier 1, 1350x940, disableStorageReset false |
| Browser | Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36, `--headless=new --no-sandbox`, 4-core container |

| Page (final URL) | LCP per run, ms | Median | At most 2500 ms? |
|:--|:--|--:|:--|
| home, lands on `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/page/showcase_capability_map` | 3516, 3557, 3513, 3602, 3624 | **3557** | no |
| object list, `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task` | 4625, 4585, 4554, 4661, 4663 | **4625** | no |
| record page, `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/record/-2h3N6M1Mg033IU4` | 4264, 4175, 4111, 4221, 4132 | **4175** | no |

The LCP element was real page content on every run: the capability map's intro text box, a cell of the task grid, and the record's title heading. FCP was about 330 ms on every page.

**This is a headless container reading, not desktop Chrome on real hardware.** Lighthouse simulates the network leg. The CPU leg is this container's, and nothing else held the verify lock while it ran. For context only (not the item's reading), Lighthouse's observed, unthrottled localhost LCP medians were 2043 / 2706 / 2582 ms. The pages transfer about 2.0 to 2.5 MB of brotli-compressed script across 150 to 239 script requests, which by itself takes about 2 s at 10 Mbps.

## Tests

No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour (ledger content only).

<details><summary>check:platform-checklist, before (main db77cc493a) and after (93707e6ed9)</summary>

Both runs exit 1 with the same single problem, which is inherited from main and outside this diff:

```text
check-platform-checklist: 1 problem(s)
  ✗ areas/automation.json: ABSENT SYMBOL — `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx#FlowItemMoreMenu`: `FlowItemMoreMenu` is not declared in ...
```

All four self-tests pass on both runs (checklist-select 45 cases, qa-rollup 82, retest-owed 57, check-platform-checklist 265). The new item adds no problem. `--anchor-census` reads 1800/1811 resolved on main and 1801/1812 after this change, so the one new anchor resolves. `checklist-select ux-conventions.first-screen-lcp` resolves 1 runnable item.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families (dispatch-gates --commands, 17), run locally at 93707e6ed9</summary>

16 exit 0: check-adr-links (and --self-test), check-closing-keyword-parity (and --self-test), check-comment-mask-corpus, plan-test-core-shards --self-test, lint check:doc-formula-expressions, check:adr-anchors, check:ci-filter-parity, check:cross-package-test-inputs, check:doc-authoring, check:driver-memory-census, check:gitlink-declared, check:nul-bytes, check:refd-timer-probe, check:watch-hint-literal. check:platform-checklist exits 1 only on the inherited problem above. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 17 of 17 accounted for. `overlap-check`: clean, exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The baseline fails all three page clauses: medians 3557 / 4625 / 4175 ms against 2500 ms. The item is `active` with steps, like the eight active items of #37165. Its first run will score those clauses FAIL until the pages get faster. No speed-up card is filed from this PR. That call belongs to the seat.
- "home" on the showcase redirects to the app's home page (the capability map), not a console Home page. The item asks the run to record the URL it lands on.
- The persona is the seeded dev admin, a platform admin. The ruling says only "logged in", and the stock boot provisions no member persona.

## Verification

Read first: the new item at the end of `areas/ux-conventions.json`, especially its `negative` and `knownGaps` (what a run must not score, and the headless caveat).

Two-minute check: `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs ux-conventions.first-screen-lcp` in the branch. Expect `1 runnable item(s)`, `P1 browser ux-conventions.first-screen-lcp`.
